verdict.rationale: Grafana documents AI-adjacent capabilities relevant to incident response — Sift's 'automated investigations... to surface likely causes' and natural-language querying — plus incident coordination and alert-to-investigation workflows, but there is no explicit documentation of an AI-generated incident summary feature for responders. Missing for 10: a documented feature that produces a written AI summary of an incident/alert context (not just anomaly detection or NL query), and independent/hands-on confirmation of such summaries in practice.
